verdict.rationale: The core product is an MIT-licensed set of skill files. The installer writes them into your own repo as ordinary files you own and can edit, and nothing updates behind your back. A hands-on probe confirmed a keyless local install that copied the tdd skill into the project directory, so the whole product runs on the user's own machine and agent with no vendor-hosted service. Missing for 10: explicit self-hosting or offline-install documentation (for example, installing from a private mirror without fetching from GitHub), and independent community corroboration of fully self-managed use.
